Problem Statement:
Given a number N followed by 2 lists A and B of N integers each. Form a 3rd list C of size N where each element of list C is the sum the respective elements in lists A and B. 
Input Description:
A number N followed by 2 lists A and B of N integers each. N <= 100000. 
Output Description:
A 3rd list C of size N where each element is the sum of the respective elements in lists A and B. 
Sample Input:
530 5 5 30 -45
1 2 3 4 5 
Sample Output:
31 7 8 34 -40
